text: You were away seven days and five of your twelve stocks did something the market did not. Adani Enterprises is the one to look at: down 6.8% on 3.8x normal volume while the Nifty sat at −0.39%, breaking yesterday's low and leaving 6.4% of the fall unexplained by its peers. Sun Pharma moved the other way, up 3.8% against a flat healthcare group and 6.9% higher than when you last checked. ITC broke its 52-week low, though BSE quotes it 0.94% away from Yahoo, so treat the price as unsettled. Bharti Airtel's 4.6x volume matched a rule you wrote.
